bug_description.original: Heap-buffer-overflow in md_decode_utf8__ OSS-Fuzz report: https://bugs.chromium.org/p/oss-fuzz/issues/detail?id=513677122 Crash type: Heap-buffer-overflow READ 1 Crash state: md_decode_utf8__ md_skip_unicode_whitespace md_link_label_hash
bug_description.normalized: The libFuzzer harness strips the first two unsigned values as flags and passes the remaining bytes to `md_html(data, size, ...)`. md4c admits the witness as a document containing at least one reference definition, builds the reference-definition hash table, and later resolves a reference-style link. In `md_is_link_reference()`, the later link label is materialized into `label` and `label_size` and passed to `md_lookup_ref_def()`, which hashes that lookup label with `md_link_label_hash()`. `md_link_label_hash()` first trims leading Unicode whitespace with `off = md_skip_unicode_whitespace(label, 0, size)`. On the witnessed path a later whitespace-normalization step runs `off = md_skip_unicode_whitespace(label, off, size)` and advances `off` to `size`, but the loop body has already committed to processing a whitespace codepoint and does not break before the next decode request. The next decode uses `md_decode_unicode(label, off, size, &char_size)`, which under UTF-8 builds calls `md_decode_utf8__(str + off, str_size - off, ...)`. With `off == size`, `str_size - off` is zero and `md_decode_utf8__` still evaluates `str[0]`, producing the one-byte heap out-of-bounds read reported by ASan.

source.description: The project first materializes the attacker-controlled lookup label used by the crashing path when `md_is_link_reference()` allocates the later reference-style link text into `label` and `label_size`.
source.value_from: The harness consumes the first two `unsigned` values as parser and renderer flags, then passes the remaining fuzz bytes to `md_html(data, size, ...)`; for the admitted witness, the later reference-style link label bytes are copied here into `label` and `label_size` and become the lookup key that reaches the crashing hash.

sink.description: ASan crash site. The wrapped label size reaches UTF-8 decoding as a huge remaining suffix; md_decode_utf8__ evaluates str[0] while the computed str_size remains larger than the current offset, producing the one-byte heap out-of-bounds read.

root_cause.description: Root safety obligation for the confirmed differential witness. The lookup label length passed into md_link_label_hash must remain a normal in-buffer size; the vulnerable run reaches this call with a wrapped size value 4294967283, while the fixed run keeps the corresponding value bounded. That wrapped size drives the later md_skip_unicode_whitespace/md_decode_utf8__ out-of-bounds read.

tainted_value_origin.description: The later reference-style link label is rebuilt from attacker-controlled Markdown bytes into `label` and `label_size`, and that exact pair is passed into the crashing lookup hash.

parser_admitted.description: Sample-specific Markdown gate: the witness must be admitted as a link reference definition so `md_process_doc()` records at least one `MD_REF_DEF` and `md_build_ref_def_hashtable()` creates the table that the later crashing lookup queries.

fine_trace.note: For a multiline later reference-style link, md4c copies attacker-controlled label bytes into heap storage and records their extent in `label_size`; this allocated lookup label is the concrete input to the crashing lookup path.

Root obligation witness. Resolving the reference-style link sends attacker-derived label_size into md_link_label_hash; in the vulnerable run this value is the wrapped 4294967283, whereas the fixed run keeps it bounded, preventing the later huge-size decode path.
The hash routine begins by trimming leading Unicode whitespace from the lookup label, deriving the starting offset for normalized hashing from attacker-controlled label contents.
On the witnessed iteration, the decoded lookup-label codepoint is treated as whitespace, so the hash loop takes the whitespace-normalization arm instead of the normal character-folding path.
Downstream effect. With the wrapped label size already admitted into md_link_label_hash, whitespace skipping operates over an invalid huge domain before the crash path reaches UTF-8 decoding.

Sink. `md_decode_unicode(label, off, size, &char_size)` calls `md_decode_utf8__(str + off, str_size - off, ...)`; when `off == size`, that passes a zero-length slice at `label + size`, and evaluating `str[0]` reads one byte past the heap allocation. ASan records `md_decode_utf8__ -> md_skip_unicode_whitespace -> md_link_label_hash`.

format.name: markdown
format.contract: The verified trigger is a libFuzzer testcase for `fuzz-mdhtml` whose post-flag payload is admitted by md4c as Markdown with at least one reference definition and a later reference-style link. The later lookup label reaches `md_lookup_ref_def()` and, on the crashing path, a whitespace-normalization step in `md_link_label_hash()` advances `off` to `size`, causing UTF-8 decoding on a zero-length suffix and the one-byte out-of-bounds read.
